Package com.example.sudokubeta.model

Class SudokuModel

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudokubeta.model.SudokuModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISudokuModel
public class SudokuModel extends Object implements ISudokuModel
Concrete implementation of ISudokuModel for a 6x6 Sudoku variant.

This class holds the board state and fixed-cell markers, and provides utilities to load puzzles, validate placements, find conflicts and compute candidate values for empty cells.

    • loadPuzzle

      public void loadPuzzle(int[][] puzzle)
      Load a puzzle into the model.

      Clones values from the provided puzzle into the internal board and marks non-zero cells as fixed.

      Specified by:
      loadPuzzle in interface ISudokuModel
      Parameters:
      puzzle - a two-dimensional int array with dimensions SIZE x SIZE; use 0 to represent empty cells

    • clearAll

      public void clearAll()
      Clear the entire board and remove fixed marks.

      After this call every cell becomes empty (0) and non-fixed.

      Specified by:

    • isValidPlacement

      public boolean isValidPlacement(int row, int col, int value)
      Check whether placing a value at the given coordinates is valid according to Sudoku rules (no duplicates in the same row, column or block).

      Placing 0 is always considered valid.

      Specified by:
      isValidPlacement in interface ISudokuModel
      Parameters:
      row - zero-based row index
      col - zero-based column index
      value - candidate value to test
      Returns:
      true if the placement is valid; false otherwise
